messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — nightly routing degrade triggered a partial canary fail at 02:17 UTC. Postmortem link: https://redwood/postmortems/2026-03-routing-regression. Need concrete action items, owners, and dates so fixes don't drift.

maria-l: Proposed action list (owner -> due):
- Add 'quarantine' timer to feature-flag pipeline (samir) -> 2026-03-30
- Implement auto-rollback when error delta >5% within 2m (tj) -> 2026-03-28
- Add per-route blast-radius caps + canary weight caps (alex) -> 2026-04-05
- Run 3-day rolling pattern analysis for last 6 months to find recurrence (maria-l) -> 2026-03-31

tj: For auto-rollback we can reuse the circuit-limiter. Example config to start with:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  auto_rollback:
    enabled: true
    window: 120s
    error_delta_pct: 5
    sample_min: 500
```

samir: +1 on quarantine timer. Proposal: if canary deviates >1% of baseline or triggers route errors, hold additional traffic for 10m and require human ack before continuing. Quick patch idea: `feature_flag.quarantine_ms = 10*60*1000`

oncall-june: During the incident we lacked per-region canary weight visibility. Add observability item: per-region weight dashboard (owner: oncall-june) -> 2026-03-29

alex: OK let's commit. I'll create tickets for each action and assign. Owners: please update the ticket with an implementation plan by EOD tomorrow. If you can't hit the due date, ping me. :memo: :eyes: cc @deploy-bot for staging smoke tests.

deploy-bot: test-deploy to staging scheduled 2026-03-25T14:00Z — will run canary timers and auto-rollback smoke test.

maria-l: Also adding a recurring retro action: quarterly check for this pattern and a new alert metric 'blast_radius_score' to catch slow radius creep.

tj: I'll write the auto-rollback unit + e2e tests. Expect PR by 2026-03-26.

samir: I'll draft the quarantine gating RFC and post to #eng-platform by EOD.

alex: Perfect. I've updated the action tracker with owners/dates and linked the tickets to the postmortem. We'll review progress in next week's ops sync and close items as PRs land. Thanks everyone.
